content.heading: Founding of ISRO
content.description: ISRO was formed as an independent space agency, marking India's formal entry into space research and exploration.

content.heading: First Satellite Launch
content.description: Aryabhata, India's first satellite, was launched with assistance from the Soviet Union, beginning India's satellite program.

content.heading: SLV-3 Success
content.description: First successful launch of the indigenous SLV-3 rocket, establishing India's capability to build and launch its own satellites.

content.heading: Chandrayaan-1
content.description: India's first lunar mission discovered water molecules on the Moon, changing our understanding of the lunar surface.

content.heading: Mars Orbiter Mission
content.description: India became the first nation to reach Mars in its maiden attempt, demonstrating ISRO's technical excellence and cost-effective approach.

content.heading: Chandrayaan-3
content.description: Successful landing near the lunar south pole, making India the fourth country to achieve a soft landing on the Moon and the first to land near the lunar south pole.
